material.description: From hy3d's live witness of the spell effects (deployed build; modErrors empty; cones, novas, orbs, zones, auras, spirals and blinks drawn per cast): pool occupancy cannot be read from the page, because fx.js counts() is not reachable from window.oscraft. Add oscraft.debug.fx() returning the counts (instances, draw calls, pool sizes per kind) under the existing debug namespace. Ownership: js/client/fx.js and its debug attachment in js/client/play.js (or wherever oscraft.debug is set). Acceptance: oscraft.debug.fx() returns a JSON-able object with a count per pool kind; CI green on ci and pages; no change to rendering. Witness: a browser call evaluating it (browser lane).

references.note: {"url":"https://github.com/AndyMik90/Aperant/blob/20250db069a849ab001ac6ab9e3e9779886ab9e2/apps/desktop/src/preload/api/modules/debug-api.ts","repo":"AndyMik90/Aperant","path":"apps/desktop/src/preload/api/modules/debug-api.ts","sha":"d75ce95125dbfeeb26764b26898df6e74566474b","why":"Renderer-facing debug API interface that exposes read-only debug views on a namespace object, the shape oscraft.debug follows; fetched and checked, the interface matches a read-only accessor pattern.","license":"unknown"}

material.subject: Expose effect pool occupancy under oscraft.debug.fx() so the page's pools can be checked
material.witness: Cause (H1, leader): oscraft.debug had no fx accessor; debug_api.js lacked a debug.fx key and play.js installDebugApi passed no fx hook. Before: probe 1792928837517-5833-c4d2c94d7c36bff7 DEBUG_KEYS actions,effects,modErrors,swap,run, debug.fx undefined. After (fix in 0533566b, origin main): witness 1792928899793-5852-3cc69f31a9aae45a (session verify-fx-pool-counts-debug-hook) FX_KEYS 15 ALL_NUMBER true HELP_HAS_FX true PLAY_HOOK_COUNT 1 RESULT PASS. ci run 40190444406 success; pages run 40190444436 success on attempt 2 (attempt 1 failed only the first-draw ceiling at median 10760 ms vs 10000; base d36cb5d passed). In-page browser evaluation not run (no browser verbs), so the browser witness named in the row remains for the browser lane.
